start_command: corepack pnpm --filter @genemap/api start:eva & corepack pnpm --filter @genemap/web dev
$prereq_comment: The repo-owned start:eva launcher creates a fresh loopback-only PostgreSQL cluster under .eva-tmp/genemap-discovery on port 45402, migrates it, and removes it on shutdown. It discovers one complete PostgreSQL installation through PG_BIN, PATH, or the standard PostgreSQL 16 Windows install; it never connects to the installed PostgreSQL service or an inherited DATABASE_URL.

args: $bin = if ($env:PG_BIN) { $env:PG_BIN } else { Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'PostgreSQL\16\bin' }; foreach ($tool in @('initdb.exe','pg_ctl.exe','createdb.exe')) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $bin $tool) -PathType Leaf)) { exit 1 } }; & (Join-Path $bin 'initdb.exe') --version
prerequisites.name: PostgreSQL 16 disposable-cluster tools
prerequisites.remedy: Install PostgreSQL 16 command-line tools or set GeneMap's owner EVA_APP_ENV PG_BIN override to the bin directory containing initdb.exe, pg_ctl.exe, and createdb.exe

prohibited_actions: no identifiable patient data (synthetic fixtures only)
no real medical data (medical data at rest is encrypted; never load real records)
never upload real genomic files to LLM paths

coverage.unautomated_reason: requires authenticated session with seeded user; wire once seeded auth fixture exists
needs a synthetic fixture genome file plus authenticated session; real genomic files must never reach LLM paths
needs an LLM mock; SKIP_LLM_KEY_CHECK=1 in test runs prohibits real spend
encrypted medical-data flows require seeded synthetic patient plus MEDICAL_DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY fixture; never real records
Stripe checkout is prohibited; mocked provider only. Note: an existing Playwright public-surface spec already covers part of the public pages

journeys.name: Login page loads and identifies GeneMap
journeys.user_impact: If the login page does not load, no user can sign in at all.

journeys.name: New user can reach the registration form from login
journeys.user_impact: A prospective user who cannot reach the registration form cannot self-onboard.

journeys.name: Public privacy policy page renders
journeys.user_impact: A medical-data app whose privacy policy is unreachable fails a basic trust and compliance expectation.
